task_description: Add Campaign Description, optional Campaign Rules, optional Demo Asset (image/video/pdf/link/text), and multi-select platforms to the Campaign create/edit form and the Post Job form; persist them into the legacy public.campaigns table (new columns via ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, written as plain VALUES, read from SELECT * maps); and render all filled fields on the campaign detail and job detail pages, each section shown only when its data exists. No mock/static data. Ships a hand-run SQL migration under supabase/.
